name: Portainer
description: Shows every Docker environment that a Portainer manages (local socket, Portainer agents and Edge agents) with its containers: state, health, restarts, image, compose project and published ports. One connection covers all your Docker hosts, without opening each host's Docker port. Read-only: it only lists environments, containers and networks. Kubernetes and Azure environments are skipped.
author: Netlens
supports: Portainer CE 2.45 with a local Docker environment (tested)
Portainer agent and Edge environments (not tested)

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
